cards.text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, invaded during the reign of Judah's king Jehoiakim, who served him three years and then rebelled (2 Kings 24:1). Now Jehoiakim has rested with his fathers (2 Kings 24:6), and his son Jehoiachin, whose mother is Nehushta, daughter of Elnathan, from Jerusalem, becomes king at eighteen. A WHOLE KINGDOM on his shoulders, friend, and I can't carry two cookie boxes without my mustache filing a complaint.
Jehoiachin reigns in Jerusalem three months. Three months on the throne isn't a reign, friend, it's a FREE TRIAL.

cards.question: Just like his father Jehoiakim, King Jehoiachin does evil in the sight of the LORD.

cards.text: At that time, the servants of Nebuchadnezzar march up to Jerusalem. Uh-oh.

cards.question: The servants of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, have marched up to Jerusalem. What happens to the city?

answers.text: It pays them to go home
It sends out its army to fight

cards.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar comes to the city himself, while his servants are still besieging it. You know it's serious when the boss stops sending emails and shows up at your desk with his coat still on.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, is at Jerusalem himself. What does King Jehoiachin do?

answers.text: He surrenders to the king of Babylon
He sneaks out of the city at night
He rides out to fight the king of Babylon

cards.question: Jehoiachin surrenders to the king of Babylon all by himself, while his mother and his officials stay out of it.

cards.text: So Nebuchadnezzar, in the eighth year of his reign, takes Jehoiachin captive. Friend, I've been picked up and carried off to the back of a drawer, and I can tell you, NOBODY asks if you're ready.

cards.question: At the house of the LORD and the royal palace, Nebuchadnezzar leaves the treasures right where they are.
Long ago, Solomon, king of Israel, made gold articles in the temple of the LORD. What does Nebuchadnezzar do with them?

answers.text: He leaves them in the temple
He hands them to his servants

cards.text: Here's the thing, friend: Nebuchadnezzar carrying off those treasures happens just as the LORD had declared.

Then he carries all Jerusalem into exile: the commanders, the mighty men of valor, the craftsmen and the metalsmiths, TEN THOUSAND captives in all. Ten THOUSAND, friend, let that one sit in the oven a second.

cards.question: The commanders, the mighty men, the craftsmen and the metalsmiths are all taken from Jerusalem. Only the ___ people of the land remain.

cards.text: Jehoiachin is carried off to Babylon, along with his mother, his officials and the leading men of the land. That's not a raid, friend, that's a rival bakery walking out the door with everybody who knows how to run the place.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar takes Jehoiachin's wives into exile in Babylon too.
The seven thousand men of valor and the thousand craftsmen and metalsmiths taken to Babylon are all strong and fit for ___.
With Jehoiachin carried off to Babylon, who chooses the next king of Judah?

cards.text: The king of Babylon makes Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's uncle, king in Jehoiachin's place and changes his name to Zedekiah. When the angel gave me my fresh start, keeping my name was the first thing I asked for, so believe me, I'd be holding that name tag with both ends of my mustache.
And that's where we set this batch down for now, friend. Trust me, Judah's story is not done yet.
